errors.unknown.where: Any screen that shows a failed request through errorMessage/errorReason, when the server answers a code this catalog lacks (such as route_not_found); {{code}} is that code

errors.network.where: Any screen, when a request gets no answer from the app's server (offline, or it failed before a reply): shown through errorMessage/errorReason by the screen that made it
errors.network.ja: アプリのサーバーから応答がありませんでした。接続を確認して、もう一度お試しください。

errors.no_line_token.where: Sign-in screen, under “Couldn’t sign you in”: LINE is logged in but hands over no ID token to sign in to the app's server with (made by the app itself, shown through errorMessage)
errors.no_line_token.ja: LINEからログインに必要な情報が届きませんでした。

errors.already_received.where: Giving, In the bag: taking a gift back out (POST /api/gifts/:giftId/take-out) that its receiver already received, in “couldn’t be taken out” through errorReason; the Receive gift dialog shows its own Already opened screen instead
errors.already_received.ja: このギフトは、すでにひらかれています。

errors.deposit_mismatch.where: Giving, In the bag: packing a sticker when the escrow's deposit (POST /api/gifts/:giftId/deposit) isn't the one packaging issued, in “couldn’t be packed” through errorReason
errors.deposit_mismatch.ja: ギフト袋に、入っているはずのシールが入っていません。

errors.deposit_not_landed.where: Giving, In the bag: packing a sticker when the escrow still has no deposit after the app's retries (POST /api/gifts/:giftId/deposit), in “couldn’t be packed” through errorReason
errors.deposit_not_landed.ja: ギフト袋は、まだブロックチェーン上にありません。

errors.gift_closed.where: Giving, In the bag: recording LINE's picker outcome (POST /api/gifts/:giftId/shared) or taking the gift out (POST …/take-out) once it's no longer packed or sent, in “couldn’t record” or “couldn’t be taken out” through errorReason
errors.gift_closed.ja: このギフトは、すでに終了しています。

errors.gift_expired.where: Receiving: opening a gift message's link (POST /api/gifts/preview or /receive) after the gift expired unopened; the Receive gift dialog shows its own returned-gift screen instead, so this is errorMessage's fallback
errors.gift_expired.ja: このギフトは、期限内にひらかれませんでした。

errors.gift_in_transit.where: Giving, In the bag: packing a sticker (POST /api/gifts) that's already in another open gift, or taking a gift out (POST …/take-out) before the escrow's take-out lands, in “couldn’t be packed” or “couldn’t be taken out” through errorReason
errors.gift_in_transit.ja: このシールは、すでにギフトとして贈られている途中です。

errors.gift_not_found.where: Giving, In the bag: a deposit, picker outcome or take-out (POST /api/gifts/:giftId/…) for a gift that doesn't exist, through errorReason; the Receive gift dialog and the Gratitude Mini-game show their own lines for it instead
errors.gift_not_found.ja: このギフトは見つかりませんでした。

errors.gift_not_received.where: Gratitude Mini-game: recording a combo (POST /api/gratitude) for a gift not received yet; the Mini-game shows its own “didn’t reach” line instead, so this is errorMessage's fallback
errors.gift_not_received.ja: このギフトは、まだ受け取られていません。

errors.gift_returned.where: Receiving: opening a gift message's link (POST /api/gifts/preview or /receive) after the gift expired and went back to its giver; the Receive gift dialog shows its own returned-gift screen instead
errors.gift_returned.ja: このギフトは、贈り主のもとに戻りました。

errors.gratitude_already_recorded.where: Gratitude Mini-game: recording a combo (POST /api/gratitude) for a gift that already has Gratitude; the Mini-game shows its own “didn’t reach” line instead, so this is errorMessage's fallback
errors.gratitude_already_recorded.ja: このギフトへの感謝は、すでに届いています。

errors.gratitude_not_found.where: Sticker detail's Transfer Trail: loading a gift's Gratitude replay (GET /api/gratitude/:giftId) when none was recorded; the replay isn't built yet, so no screen shows this today
errors.gratitude_not_found.ja: このギフトへの感謝は、まだありません。

errors.group_chat.where: Receiving: opening a gift message's link in a group chat (POST /api/gifts/preview or /receive); the Receive gift dialog shows its own “Open this in your chat” screen instead
errors.group_chat.ja: ギフトは、送られた1対1のトークでしかひらけません。

errors.handle_invalid.where: Handle prompt: saving a handle (POST /api/me/handle) that breaks the rules; the prompt shows its own api.handle.invalid line instead, so this is errorMessage's fallback
errors.handle_invalid.ja: そのユーザー名は、ルールに合っていません。

errors.handle_taken.where: Handle prompt: saving a handle (POST /api/me/handle) someone else has; the prompt shows its own api.handle.taken line instead, so this is errorMessage's fallback
errors.handle_taken.ja: そのユーザー名は、ほかの人が使っています。

errors.internal_error.where: Any screen, when the server fails unexpectedly (500), through errorMessage/errorReason; also the Ticket shop after paying, when Sui doesn't verify the payment (POST /api/ticket-purchases)
errors.internal_error.ja: アプリのサーバーで問題が発生しました。

errors.invalid_request.where: Any screen, when the server can't read a request (400), through errorMessage/errorReason; e.g. the Drawing screen's seal chip when a seal's images are malformed (POST /api/stickers)
errors.invalid_request.ja: アプリが送った内容を、サーバーが読み取れませんでした。

errors.line_token_invalid.where: Sign-in screen, under “Couldn’t sign you in”: signing in to the app's server (POST /api/session) when LINE refuses the ID token, such as an expired one, through errorMessage
errors.line_token_invalid.ja: LINEであなたのアカウントを確認できませんでした。

errors.mint_failed.where: Drawing screen, after tapping the check to seal: the seal chip's reason when the sticker saved but its NFT mint wasn't confirmed (POST /api/stickers), through errorReason
errors.mint_failed.ja: シールは保存されましたが、ブロックチェーン上で仕上げられませんでした。もう一度お試しください。チケットを新たに使うことはありません。

errors.no_tickets_left.where: Drawing screen, starting a sticker: spending a ticket (POST /api/tickets/spend) with no daily or reserve tickets left, in the start note's “Couldn’t use a ticket” through errorReason
errors.no_tickets_left.ja: チケットが残っていません。

errors.not_deposited.where: Giving, In the bag: recording that the gift was sent (POST /api/gifts/:giftId/shared) before its deposit landed in the escrow, in “couldn’t record” through errorReason; the Receive gift dialog shows its own “Almost here” screen instead
errors.not_deposited.ja: このギフトは、まだ送られていません。

errors.not_giver.where: Sticker detail's Transfer Trail: marking a Gratitude replay watched (POST /api/gratitude/:giftId/seen) by anyone but the gift's giver; the replay isn't built yet, so no screen shows this today
errors.not_giver.ja: それができるのは贈り主だけです。

errors.not_minted.where: Giving, In the bag: packing a sticker (POST /api/gifts) whose NFT isn't minted yet, in “couldn’t be packed” through errorReason
errors.not_minted.ja: このシールは、まだブロックチェーン上で仕上がっていません。

errors.not_receiver.where: Gratitude Mini-game: recording a combo (POST /api/gratitude) on a gift someone else received; the Mini-game shows its own “didn’t reach” line instead, so this is errorMessage's fallback
errors.not_receiver.ja: それができるのは、ギフトを受け取った人だけです。

errors.not_yours.where: Giving, In the bag: packing a sticker someone else holds (POST /api/gifts), or a deposit, picker outcome or take-out on someone else's gift, through errorReason
errors.not_yours.ja: そのシールは、あなたのものではありません。

errors.own_gift.where: Receiving: the giver opening their own gift message's link (POST /api/gifts/preview or /receive); the Receive gift dialog shows its own “This gift is on its way” screen instead
errors.own_gift.ja: 自分が贈ったギフトは、ひらけません。

errors.pack_unknown.where: Ticket shop, after paying: adding the tickets (POST /api/ticket-purchases) for a pack size the shop doesn't sell, in “The payment went through, but the tickets weren’t added” through errorReason
errors.pack_unknown.ja: そのチケットパックはありません。

errors.payment_already_counted.where: Ticket shop, after paying: adding the tickets (POST /api/ticket-purchases) for a Sui payment that already bought tickets, in “The payment went through, but the tickets weren’t added” through errorReason
errors.payment_already_counted.ja: その支払いは、すでに反映されています。

errors.payment_short.where: Ticket shop, after paying: adding the tickets (POST /api/ticket-purchases) when the payment is below the pack's price at every quote still valid, in “…the tickets weren’t added” through errorReason
errors.payment_short.ja: 支払い額が足りませんでした。

errors.replay_invalid.where: Gratitude Mini-game: recording a combo (POST /api/gratitude) whose replay fails the server's checks; the Mini-game shows its own “didn’t reach” line instead, so this is errorMessage's fallback
errors.replay_invalid.ja: 感謝のリプレイを読み取れませんでした。

errors.signed_out.where: Any screen, when a request has no valid session (the cookie expired, or the account was deleted), through errorMessage/errorReason
errors.signed_out.ja: ログアウトしています。

errors.sticker_not_found.where: Sticker detail: loading where it's been (GET /api/stickers/:stickerId), in “Couldn’t load where it’s been…”, or Giving: packing it (POST /api/gifts), in “couldn’t be packed”, through errorReason
errors.sticker_not_found.ja: このシールは見つかりませんでした。

errors.sticker_placement_not_found.where: Your sticker board: saving where a sticker sits after you move it (PATCH /api/sticker-boards/me/sticker-placements/:stickerId) when it never reached you, in “Couldn’t save where … sits” through errorReason
errors.sticker_placement_not_found.ja: そのシールは、あなたのシールボードにありません。

errors.sui_price_unavailable.where: Ticket shop: getting the SUI price quote (GET /api/ticket-quote) when no SUI/JPY price is available, in “Couldn’t get today’s prices” through errorReason
errors.sui_price_unavailable.ja: 今日の価格を、いまは取得できません。

errors.taken_back.where: Receiving: opening a gift message's link (POST /api/gifts/preview or /receive) after the giver took the gift back; the Receive gift dialog shows its own “took this one back” screen instead
errors.taken_back.ja: 贈り主がこのギフトを取り消しました。

errors.ticket_already_used.where: Drawing screen, after tapping the check to seal: the seal chip's reason when the drawing's ticket already became a sticker (POST /api/stickers), through errorReason
errors.ticket_already_used.ja: そのチケットは、すでに使われています。

errors.ticket_kind_changed.where: Drawing screen, starting a sticker: spending a ticket (POST /api/tickets/spend) when the next one isn't the daily or reserve kind the start card offered, in “Couldn’t use a ticket” through errorReason
errors.ticket_kind_changed.ja: チケットの状況が変わりました。もう一度お試しください。

errors.ticket_not_found.where: Drawing screen, after tapping the check to seal: the seal chip's reason when the ticket the drawing started on doesn't exist (POST /api/stickers), through errorReason
errors.ticket_not_found.ja: そのチケットは見つかりませんでした。

errors.ticket_not_yours.where: Drawing screen, after tapping the check to seal: the seal chip's reason when the ticket the drawing started on is someone else's (POST /api/stickers), through errorReason
errors.ticket_not_yours.ja: そのチケットは、あなたのものではありません。

errors.timelapse_not_found.where: Sticker detail: loading a sticker's timelapse (GET /api/stickers/:stickerId/timelapse) when it was sealed without one; the timelapse player isn't built yet, so no screen shows this today
errors.timelapse_not_found.ja: このシールは、タイムラプスなしで仕上げられました。

errors.user_not_found.where: An artist's sticker board: loading their board or stats (GET /api/sticker-boards/:userId, …/user-stats) for a person who doesn't exist, in “Couldn’t load …’s board” or “Their stats didn’t load” through errorReason
errors.user_not_found.ja: そのアーティストは見つかりませんでした。

api.signIn.opening.where: Sign-in screen, right after the LINE sign-in screen while the app signs in to its server with LINE's ID token: the status line
api.signIn.opening.ja: シールボードをひらいています…

api.signIn.failed.where: Sign-in screen, when signing in to the app's server fails: the heading above the error's message and a Try again button
api.signIn.failed.ja: ログインできませんでした

api.signIn.tryAgain.where: Sign-in screen, after signing in to the app's server failed: the button that retries the sign-in

api.handle.title.where: Handle prompt, on a first sign-in whose LINE name couldn't become the handle, before the app opens: the heading
api.handle.title.ja: ユーザー名を決めましょう

api.handle.lead.where: Handle prompt, when LINE gave no display name: the line under the heading
api.handle.lead.ja: みんながあなたやあなたのシールを見つけるときに使う名前です。

api.handle.leadNameTaken.where: Handle prompt, when the LINE display name ({{name}}) couldn't become the handle, normally because someone has it: the line under the heading
api.handle.leadNameTaken.ja: @{{name}}はすでにほかの人が使っているので、あなただけのユーザー名を決めてください。みんながあなたやあなたのシールを見つけるときに使う名前です。

api.handle.field.where: Handle prompt: the handle input's accessible label, read by screen readers

api.handle.placeholder.where: Handle prompt: the placeholder in the empty handle input, after the @ icon

api.handle.tooLong.where: Handle prompt, while typing: the problem line under the input once the handle is longer than {{max}} characters

api.handle.taken.where: Handle prompt, after tapping Use @handle: the problem line when the server answers handle_taken
api.handle.taken.ja: @{{handle}}はすでに使われています。別のユーザー名をお試しください。

api.handle.invalid.where: Handle prompt, after tapping Use @handle: the problem line when the server answers handle_invalid
api.handle.invalid.ja: ユーザー名は「@」なしの1〜{{max}}文字です。

api.handle.couldntSave.where: Handle prompt, after tapping Use @handle: the problem line when saving fails any other way; {{reason}} is errorReason's message with the server's detail
api.handle.couldntSave.ja: ユーザー名を保存できませんでした：{{reason}}

api.handle.use.where: Handle prompt: the submit button once a handle is typed, naming it

api.handle.pick.where: Handle prompt: the submit button, disabled, while the handle input is empty

line.gate.opening.where: LINE sign-in screen, while LINE (LIFF) starts up as the app opens: the status line
line.gate.opening.ja: シールボードをひらいています…

line.gate.title.where: LINE sign-in screen, in a browser outside LINE before LINE Login: the heading
line.gate.title.ja: あなたのシールボード

line.gate.lead.where: LINE sign-in screen, in a browser outside LINE before LINE Login: the line under the heading
line.gate.lead.ja: LINEアカウントでひらきます。

line.gate.logIn.where: LINE sign-in screen, in a browser outside LINE: the button that starts LINE Login

line.gate.didntStart.where: LINE sign-in screen, when LINE (LIFF) fails to start or doesn't start in time: the heading
line.gate.didntStart.ja: LINEが起動しませんでした

line.gate.didntStartLead.where: LINE sign-in screen, when LINE (LIFF) fails to start: the line under the heading, above Try again and LINE's reason in fine print
line.gate.didntStartLead.ja: 起動すると、シールボードがひらきます。接続を確認して、もう一度お試しください。

line.gate.tryAgain.where: LINE sign-in screen, when LINE (LIFF) fails to start: the button that reloads the page
